body:
archive_path="${1|/path/to/archive, "${pathToArchive}"|}"
source_path="${2|/path/to/directory-or-file,"${pathToDirectoryOrFile}"|}"
case ${archive_path} in
  -*) archive_path=./${archive_path} ;;
esac
case ${source_path} in
  -*) source_path=./${source_path} ;;
esac
zip -rq "${archive_path}.zip" "${source_path}"
